weapons.name: Complimentary Crowbar
weapons.description: Issued to every new crawler at the entrance. The System calls it a 'welcome gift'. The invoice arrives later.
weapons.synergy_notes: Baseline melee. Matches the current prototype swing exactly (reach 32, 0.5s, d6, ~0.45 dot arc).

weapons.name: Promotional Box Cutter
weapons.description: Still has the sponsor's logo on the grip. Opens packages, envelopes and, regrettably, rats.
weapons.synergy_notes: Bleed build core. Fast DEX hits stack bleeding; pairs with Serrated Lanyard and Open Wounds.

weapons.name: Demolition Maul
weapons.description: Rated for load-bearing walls. The dungeon's walls are not load-bearing. Neither, it turns out, are kneecaps.
weapons.synergy_notes: Juggernaut core. Wide cleave hits crowds; pairs with Hazard Vest, Spite Battery and Iron Gut.

weapons.name: Mop-Handle Pike
weapons.description: A janitorial implement with a kitchen knife duct-taped to the business end. The custodial union has filed a grievance.
weapons.synergy_notes: Reach weapon: keeps chasers at the tip. Thrust pierces up to 2 enemies in a line.

weapons.name: Novelty Flail
weapons.description: A bowling ball on a chain, won at a prize booth that does not exist. Spin to win. Win is not guaranteed.
weapons.synergy_notes: Crowd control: full-circle spin that slows. Pairs with Mandatory Hype to keep groups clumped.

weapons.name: Sponsor-Grade Nail Pistol
weapons.description: Fires roofing nails at a velocity the manufacturer describes as 'not for use on people'. Good thing these aren't people.
weapons.synergy_notes: Baseline ranged. Matches the current prototype shot exactly (215 px/s, 0.28s, d6, 2s lifetime).

weapons.name: Confetti Scattergun
weapons.description: Loaded with party confetti and, for reasons of audience engagement, scrap metal. Every shot is a celebration.
weapons.synergy_notes: Close-range burst. Four pellets each roll to hit; ignition chance rolls per pellet, so it feeds the Arsonist build.

weapons.name: Siege Crossbow
weapons.description: Built to breach castle gates and repurposed for breaching whatever is in front of you. Reloading is a full-body workout.
weapons.synergy_notes: Slow, heavy, pierces 2 and slows. Kiter build; Ricochet Floor Wax adds a third pierce.

weapons.name: Triple-Tap Staple Rifle
weapons.description: Three staples per trigger pull. The staples were stored in a damp crate for an unknown period. Tetanus is a feature.
weapons.synergy_notes: Burst of 3 that stacks poison. Each staple rolls separately, so on-hit effects trigger often.

weapons.name: Complimentary Laser Pointer
weapons.description: Warning label: do not point at eyes, ceilings, or anything flammable. The dungeon is mostly flammable.
weapons.synergy_notes: Placeholder beam: integration treats it as a short hitscan tick every 0.2s. Arsonist capstone.
